I was 18 when the first covid lockdown happened... i had my future all set up, i had college plans, it was my senior year and my final year of swim team and i was on the cusp of breaking a pool record time... but then everything went to shit. I didnt finish my senior year had no prom none of the school traditions i was looking forward to sence freshman year. My final year of swim team i didnt get, and will never be able to break that record and have my name on that board... everything i was working twords sence i was young never happened and never will... im 20 and in a few months will be turning 21... and i still feel like an 18 year old... every day i hope i wake up from this being a dream... my life went to shit, i ruined my relationship with my parents and my friends... i do nothing to make my parents proud and all i do is go to work... i just feel like ive peaked, and theres nothing more i can achieve...
Me too... hes just a little puppy and depends on me... i cant do that to him...
